_comment: Bulgarian/English false friends. 'word' is the English word; 'looks_like' is what a Bulgarian speaker assumes it means (the trap); 'actually' is the real meaning. 'vo' is the Bulgarian voice-over line for the scene. Edit freely — the assembler reads this file. 'prompt' is the ComfyUI image prompt; deliberately objects/places, never people, since the model is weak at hands. DEMO DECK — a handful of example entries so a fresh clone runs. Replace this file with your own, or drop a private deck beside it as '<name>.local.json' (gitignored), which takes precedence.

items.vo: Magazine не е магазин. Означава списание. Магазинът е shop или store.
items.prompt: a stack of glossy magazines fanned out on a marble coffee table, soft morning window light, shallow depth of field

items.vo: В Америка biscuit не е бисквита, а мека солена питка. Бисквитата е cookie.
items.prompt: warm golden buttermilk biscuits in a cast iron skillet, steam rising, rustic kitchen table, cinematic light

items.vo: Accord не е музикален акорд. Означава споразумение. Акордът е chord.
items.prompt: two fountain pens resting on a signed formal document, dark wood desk, dramatic side lighting

items.vo: Brilliant не е брилянт. Означава блестящ или гениален. Брилянтът е diamond.
items.prompt: a chalkboard covered in elegant mathematical equations, warm library light, books stacked nearby

items.vo: Velvet е кадифе, не рипсено кадифе. Велветът на български е corduroy.
items.prompt: deep emerald velvet fabric draped in soft folds, catching studio light, luxurious texture macro

items.vo: List не е лист хартия. Означава списък. Листът е sheet или leaf.
items.prompt: a handwritten checklist on a notepad beside a coffee cup, overhead flat lay, morning light
